budget_1_2_star.sourceTitle: Hotel Data for Researchers & Academics — HOTEVI
budget_1_2_star.evidenceText: The HOTEVI sample table identifies the exact row Paris | France | 2,056 hotels | Budget $70. The page describes the table as average nightly rates in USD by star tier and defines Budget as 1-2 star. This is retained as a source-defined standard-room grouped proxy; occupancy and tax treatment are not stated.
budget_1_2_star.referencePeriod: Monthly average; HOTEVI research page cites HOTEVI Hotel Price Index retrieved July 30, 2026; the research page does not specify a calendar index month.
budget_1_2_star.searchQuery: site:hotevi.com/research Paris France HOTEVI research hotel rates
budget_1_2_star.reason: Exact city/country row, positive USD monthly average, and published 1-2-star group identity are present. This remains a grouped proxy and is not an observed two-adult product tier.
